Package hadur117.micro.core

Class Energy

java.lang.Object
hadur117.micro.core.Energy
public final class Energy extends Object
Bullet power and the fire gate: Figment's log10(energy) * 325 / distance (about 3 at 200 px, 1 at 650 px), capped at others / 3 + 1.9: 1.9 while fewer than three opponents remain (SAOR-8), where the end game is scored on survival and 1.9 keeps two shots of margin against a 3-power hit; 2.9 with three to five; no cap the engine does not apply itself above that. The gun fires only once it has finished turning (SAOR-10).

      public static double power(double energy, double distance, int others)
      The power to fire at the target. Below 0.1 the engine fires 0.1, so a robot under 1 energy still fires; Figment's power > 0 check cost 6 bytes (docs/saor.md).

      distance - the target's distance
